description: Generate a supplied-entropy Lamport key pair, sign once, verify, and fingerprint the source-shaped outputs.

input.encoding: [message_length, message_bytes..., verify_message_length, verify_message_bytes..., tamper_index, sign_twice, entropy_bytes...]
input.tamper_index_meaning: -1 leaves the signature unchanged; otherwise XOR bit 0 at the selected byte in the verification copy.
input.entropy_order: 512 consecutive 32-byte secrets ordered by bit position, then value 0 and 1.

output.meaning: low 63 bits of FNV-1a-64 over the public key bytes in bit/value order, the generated signature bytes, and one verification byte (1 or 0).
